candidates.title: Three Threat Groups Target Russian Enterprises With Backdoors, Ransomware, and Wipers
candidates.summary: Enterprises in Russia have emerged as the target of three threat activity clusters tracked as NightEagle, Hacking Cat, and Toy Ghouls, according to multiple reports from Kaspersky.
